review_notes: I read the whole file. It has four theorems (smul_pi_subset, smul_univ_pi, smul_pi, smul_pi₀) and none carries a simp attribute. I grepped Mathlib for uses of smul_univ_pi, smul_pi₀ and smul_pi_subset and found none outside the file, so I have no downstream simp call site to justify a change. The unconditional equalities smul_pi and smul_univ_pi could be simp lemmas. The right-hand side `pi s (r • t)` is a `Pi.smul` on a family of sets, so I don't think it is clearly a simpler normal form. smul_pi₀ has a side condition `r ≠ 0`, which makes it a poor simp candidate. The subset lemma is not an equation and so is not a simp lemma either. I found no competing rules, no rewrite cycle and no wrongly oriented lemma. I did not check whether other pointwise-Pi simp lemmas exist elsewhere in Mathlib, so some uncertainty remains there. Under this rubric I report nothing.
